Frequently Asked Questions

What is RRU Rental?

A managed digital rental inquiry capture and qualification system that converts prospective renter inquiries into structured Renter Intelligence Briefs for human agent follow-up[cite: 7].

Does RRU Rental approve or deny renters?

No. RRU Rental is an information-organization utility and does not make final rental decisions or approve/deny applicants[cite: 7].

How long does deployment take?

Your system is targeted for deployment within 72 hours after receiving your required business and onboarding information[cite: 7].

Fair Housing Disclaimer: RRU Rental is designed as a standardized rental inquiry and information-organization utility and is not intended to make discriminatory leasing decisions. The customer remains responsible for applying lawful rental criteria consistently and for complying with all applicable federal, NYS, and NYC housing requirements[cite: 7].
